name: Set.ext
statement: lemma Set.ext (s t : Set α) : s = t ↔ ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ x ∈ t
proof:
:= by {
  constructor
  · intro h x
    rw [h]
  · intro h
    funext x
    apply propext
    exact h x

name: Set.ext'
statement: lemma Set.ext' (s t : Set α) : s = t ↔ ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ x ∈ t
proof:
:= by {
  conv =>
    rhs
    ext
    rw [← eq_iff_iff]
  exact Function.funext_iff

name: Set.mem_setOf
statement: lemma Set.mem_setOf (p : α → Prop) (x : α) : x ∈ my{x' | p x'} ↔ p x

name: Set.mem_union
statement:
lemma Set.mem_union (s t : Set α) (x : α) :
    x ∈ Set.union s t ↔ x ∈ s ∨ x ∈ t

name: Set.mem_inter_iff
statement:
lemma Set.mem_inter_iff (s t : Set α) (x : α) :
    x ∈ Set.inter s t ↔ x ∈ s ∧ x ∈ t

name: my_lemma
statement: lemma my_lemma {a b c : ℝ} (h : a + b = a + c) : b = c

name: Tendsto_iff
statement:
lemma Tendsto_iff {X Y : Type _} (f : X → Y)
    (F : Filter X) (G : Filter Y) :
    Tendsto f F G ↔ ∀ S : Set Y, S ∈ G → f ⁻¹' S ∈ F

name: fact1
statement: theorem fact1 : a * b * 2 ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 ≤ a ^ 2 - 2 * a * b + b ^ 2
  calc
    a ^ 2 - 2 * a * b + b ^ 2 = (a - b) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≥ 0 := by apply pow_two_nonneg
  linarith

name: fact2
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 ≤ a ^ 2 + 2 * a * b + b ^ 2
  calc
    a ^ 2 + 2 * a * b + b ^ 2 = (a + b) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≥ 0 := by apply pow_two_nonneg
  linarith

name: aux
statement: theorem aux : min a b + c ≤ min (a + c) (b + c)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_min
  · apply add_le_add_right
    apply min_le_left
  apply add_le_add_right
  apply min_le_right

name: absorb1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply inf_le_left
  apply le_inf
  · apply le_refl
  apply le_sup_left

name: absorb2
statement: theorem absorb2 : x ⊔ x ⊓ y = x
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply sup_le
    · apply le_refl
    apply inf_le_left
  apply le_sup_left

name: aux1
statement: theorem aux1 (h : a ≤ b) : 0 ≤ b - a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_self a, sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_comm b]
  apply add_le_add_left h

name: aux2
statement: theorem aux2 (h : 0 ≤ b - a) : a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_zero a, ← sub_add_cancel b a, add_comm (b - a)]
  apply add_le_add_left h
